fusions.name: Falcon's Stoop
fusions.desc: Dives you up to 7 tiles onto an enemy. The strike deals 12 damage, rising to 1.8 times that from the full distance.

fusions.name: Talons Close
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health. Seizes it with a grip that deals 20 damage and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Standing Takeoff
fusions.desc: Leaps you instantly to a point up to 7 tiles away. You move 15% faster for 4 seconds after you land.

fusions.name: Gathered Airspeed
fusions.desc: Every few paces you cover, your critical hit chance rises by 30% for your next strike. Once every 8 seconds.
